required_checks: Fixture-run (when authorized elsewhere) each labeled probe against both unrepaired and repaired inspect_cases and record observed_status/detected; confirm nondelegated-core-field-mutated, invocations-list-typed, adapter-frame-key-injected, and source-trace-event-dropped flip supported→counterexample only after the packet fixes.

Confirm retained core field name for nondelegated exact() (staged vs stage_serial vs other) against a_audit.py exact(before['core'], after['core']) and adjust the mutator to a real core key present after source-handled steps.

Add an isolated charge-exhaustion probe (or delete the charge-escape coverage claim) that shows whether inspect_cases returns 'unproved' with preserved counts versus raising and dropping audited_prefixes.
Verify REFUSED/DELEGATED/SRC_EV/MULTI/SRC_TR witnesses actually bind on the intended case corpus; treat missing-witness skips as incomplete suite, not green.
Confirm _digest/_apply reseal matches adapter_traces digest binding for the plain (non-typed-certificate) case shape these controls mutate.
reservations: new_executions_allowed=0 / scientific_status BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED: nothing executed; parse and discrimination are inferred from embedded untrusted bytes only.
origin_state=unknown and origin_acceptance=false: bytes reviewed, not producer intent or prior admission.

reference_source is boundary-01 owned controls (durable precharge, typed certificates, attributed exceptions); API/shape divergence from this obligation runner is expected but means reference cannot validate o12 semantics.
Line anchors and cited implement/control-build behaviors come from the obligation packet, not re-read files in this pass.
Even a green control report would not authorize checker acceptance or close remaining implement/control-build verdict asymmetry without separate checker repair.
strengths: No imports of reducers, guards, inventory, or original model modules; only copy/hashlib/json.
Tests the supplied inspect_cases on deep-copied mutated retained cases rather than a restated local oracle.
Hash-resealed semantic probes for invocation/mask/decision/core mutations; invocations-list-typed marked canonical_json_identical so digest coincidence cannot be misread as a catch.
detected is True only when observed_status=='counterexample'; charge refusal and non-counterexample outcomes are not counted as semantic catches.
Witness locate + skipped/missing-witness limitations; empty cases short-circuit; explicit no-acceptance / bounded-to-supplied-cases limitations.

Control surface covers the main wave06 discrimination themes that the packet says prior control-build missed: corebump on source-handled steps, list-typed invocations, row observation pop, q_profile reverse, frame key inject, source event drop.
review.summary: Static review only: the o12 independent-controls proposal is self-contained (stdlib only), injects inspect_cases rather than mocking the obligation, and adds hash-resealed/canonical probes that target most wave06 discrimination gaps (nondelegated core drift, list/row-key leniency, q_profile binding, frame-key injection, source-trace drop) with detected=True gated strictly on status=='counterexample'. It is not lead-ready: it overclaims charge-escape coverage, leaves soft rejected/unproved signaling, and field/anchor identities versus the obligation packet remain unverified without fixtures.
